name: Mountain Climber

instructions.description: Begin in a high plank with hands under shoulders and body in a straight line.
Brace your trunk and draw one knee toward your chest without bouncing the hips up.
Quickly switch legs in a running motion while keeping the shoulders steady over the hands.
Slow down and return both feet to the floor when the interval ends.

performanceMetrics.notes: Use timed work intervals with quality movement.

variations.variationDescription: Uses a similar plank support position but adds alternating lower-limb drive for conditioning.

variationSuggestions.variationDescription: Place hands on a bench to reduce upper-body load.

commentsNotes: Avoid bouncing through the lower back.
Speed should never compromise trunk control.
